title: Protests planned regarding Zwarte Piet event in Steenwijk

tea.why: Protesters oppose the traditional depiction of Zwarte Piet, which they view as racist, while supporters aim to preserve the tradition.
tea.want: The counter-protesters seek an inclusive and safe community, while the other group aims to maintain the traditional Zwarte Piet image.
tea.changed: Nov 25: Local authorities confirmed the Zwarte Piet event is registered as a demonstrative walk.

summary: On November 29, 2026, two opposing demonstrations are scheduled to take place in Steenwijk during a shopping Sunday. A citizen initiative supported by the Forum voor Democratie (FVD) plans to walk through the city center with traditional Zwarte Piet figures to demonstrate the character's continued popularity and provide entertainment for children. In response, the group De Roe voor Racisme, linked to Regenboog Steenwijkerland, has organized a silent counter-protest. The counter-protesters argue that the traditional depiction of Zwarte Piet is discriminatory and racist, and they advocate for a more inclusive society. The counter-protest is scheduled to begin at 13:00 on the Markt, followed by the Zwarte Piet event at 13:30. The municipality of Steenwijkerland has confirmed that the Zwarte Piet event is officially registered as a demonstrative walk.
demands: Promote an inclusive and safe community
response: A spokesperson for the municipality of Steenwijkerland stated that the Zwarte Piet event is registered as a 'demonstrative walk' aimed at preserving the traditional image of the character.

updates.text: De Roe voor Racisme announced a silent counter-protest against the planned Zwarte Piet event.
The municipality confirmed the Zwarte Piet event is registered as a demonstrative walk.
